problem: Does internal observation at every retained cell satisfy extension coherence, with the failure of finite-stage exhaustion represented exactly by a boundary-supported residue jet?
bold_conjecture: For the diagonal internal observer, same-cell extension naturality is exact and each one-grade extension contributes one orthogonal rank-one residue map; cumulative residues reconstruct the enlarged observer relative to the embedded earlier stage.
named_rivals: scalar terminal residue without grade support

definitions.embedding: i_n embeds the first n grade coordinates into n+1 coordinates
definitions.jet: ordered family (R_n,R_(n+1),...) indexed by extension grade

acceptance_tests: one-step observer difference equals the new boundary residue
successive residue sum reconstructs the enlarged observer relative to the base observer
hostile relabelling produces a nonzero naturality residual
claim_boundary: Exact finite matrix theorem for extension coherence and boundary residue jets of diagonal observation. Extension index is cutoff/grade order, not physical time. No nonseparable quantum entanglement or physical obligation semantics is asserted.
